capabilities: Rate media entries with five-star and 10-point scores
Set two-state planned/completed status with configurable labels
Search TMDB and Open Library to create new media notes
Browse the library as a cover-based Bookshelf view with filters, search, and sorting
Track comments, status history, and finished/updated dates in note properties
disambiguation: Not a media file player or embed manager; it manages a catalog of media notes (books, movies, TV) inside Bases.
extras: Warns users to back up the vault before enabling a version that performs a schema migration (media notes are migrated to schema 2). Notes TMDB attribution requirements and that the plugin is not endorsed by TMDB. Open Library search needs no API key.
intentEvidence: turns Obsidian Bases into an editable media library
problem: Obsidian Bases tables are not directly editable and building a media library requires manually editing properties and looking up movie and book metadata elsewhere.

relations.evidence: Movie and TV metadata is provided by The Movie Database (TMDB).
Book metadata and covers are provided by Open Library, a project of the Internet Archive.

requires.name: TMDB account to obtain the API key

summary: Editable media library built on Obsidian Bases, with a table view, a cover-based Bookshelf view, ratings, statuses, and TMDB/Open Library entry creation.
